title: Bills players express concern over ability of training staff to help them recover in 2025 NFL team report cards

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bills players express concern over ability of training staff to help them recover in 2025 NFL team report cards
sources.description: Buffalo Bills players expressed concerns with the team’s training staff via the 2025 NFL team report cards, which the league stopped the NFLPA from publishing due to an arbitration ruling.
